reviews.text: Got a gel pedicure from Victoria it was really nice and she is a vibe and fun to talk to and my nails look great

I had to go 2 different days,but it was worth it. My first day I sat in Mallory's seat and said I want it short. Can you please give me something easy to take care of. OMG she did and she showed me 2 awesome ways to do my hair. Then I went back to get my hair colored and all I said was its summer and she new exactly what I wanted.Thank you so much for giving me exactly what I wanted

After being disappointed with my last cut I decided to go to Blondie's. I am so happy I did! Mallory washed and cut my long, thinning hair. She is very nice and friendly. I absolutely love the cut/style and enjoyed talking with her. She really made me feel comfortable and confident with the change. I will definitely go back again! Thanks Mallory!!
